thread:
maya: Quick sync — proposing a small 'smokewalk' stage in the model intake pipeline. Run 3 lightweight checks in staging (perf smoke, generation sanity, KV-cache load) that finish within ~5m. Goal: catch obvious runtime regressions before the full bench. Thoughts?

raj: +1. Do we need separate infra for this or can the current validator service handle it?

lin: Prefer reusing validator, but make sure it's a lightweight mode. We can run CPU-only for some checks to avoid queuing on GPUs.

jen: Question on thresholds — what counts as a fail for latency / quality?

maya: Initial idea: p50 <= 250ms for gen_small (512 tokens), p95 <= 700ms. Quality: small eval set, perplexity delta < 1.0 vs reference. If fail, auto-block admission and attach logs/trace.

sam: +1. Also need to validate model format/adapter loads (torch -> onnx -> tvm fallback). We often see adapter mismatches cause runtime errors.

maya: Agreed — smokewalk will verify that the runtime adapter can load the model and run a forward pass for each supported execution path. Example command for local dev: 
```
./tools/run_smokewalk.sh --model-path /tmp/model --profile gen_small --tasks "sanity,gpu-load,adapter" --timeout 300
```
This returns a JSON summary and uploads logs to the staging artifacts bucket.

bench-bot: bench results for last run: gen_small p50 210ms p95 650ms, KV miss 1.2% — all under thresholds :white_check_mark:

raj: Need a clear artifact in the registry marking smokewalk PASS/FAIL + link to logs. Also add a skip_smokewalk flag for authors doing fast iter.

lin: Agree. Add gating semantics: smokewalk failure -> block admission, but allow manual override with audit comment. Also add automatic retry x2 with exponential backoff for infra flakiness.

jen: Can we store the seed prompt set + deterministic RNG seed used for the quality checks? That makes debugging regressions reproducible.

maya: Yes — we'll store a minimal replay set (<=50 prompts) and the RNG seed in model metadata (smokewalk.seed, smokewalk.replay_url). Exposed in Console.

sam: I'll open a small PR to add adapter load tests to the validator service and a CLI hook to trigger smokewalk locally. tagging @eng-ml for visibility.

maya: Awesome — I'll draft an RFC follow-up with the thresholds, gating rules, and a short implement plan (validator changes, registry artifact, console exposure). Next sync Wed 11am.

jen: Thanks — that timeline works for me.

raj: cc @eng-platform we might want a tiny autoscale bump for smokewalk spikes in staging.

lin: One more ask: record the execution path (e.g., quantized->tvm) in the artifact so we can map regressions to kernel selection.

maya: Good call — we'll add an execution_path field to the smokewalk summary.

sam: LGTM.

maya: Closing loop here — follow-up RFC by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
